## Checklist

- [ ] The PR targets the right base branch (`develop` for features and fixes)
- [ ] `bun run lint` and `bun run typecheck` pass locally
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] A Prisma migration is included if `schema.prisma` changed
- [ ] `backend/.env.example` is updated if new env vars were added
- [ ] `ARCHITECTURE.md` or other docs are updated if the structure changed
